_doc: Forge V2 WAVE G1 (2026-07-19) — the per-Boss LEAST-PRIVILEGE matrix (doctrine #4): each Boss has a MAX tier + an explicit allow-list of mcp-registry.json server ids. A Boss may never obtain a tool above its max_tier or from a server it is not listed for — forge-mcp-gate.cjs::validateGrant() enforces both independently (tier<=max_tier AND server present in allow_servers), so an entry can never accidentally widen scope by only editing one side. Boss ids match config/agents/agent-registry.json exactly (the 12 permanent Bosses); a boss not listed here defaults to max_tier:0, allow_servers:[] (no MCP grant at all — native fallback only) rather than an implicit wide grant. Tier 3 (WRITE-PRIMITIVE) is NEVER granted by default to any Boss, even one whose max_tier could numerically cover it — validateGrant() hard-requires opts.ownerGrant PLUS a live forge-actiongate.cjs confirmation for every tier-3 request, regardless of what this file says. This file only ever WIDENS what a Boss may attempt to request; it never itself authorizes a write.

boss.why: The Lead orchestrates and delegates — it does not call MCP tools directly.

head-chef.why: Task decomposition/verification does not require direct MCP tool access.

review-boss.why: Final QA needs read-only GitHub context (PRs/issues/code) and versioned docs — never write access.

test-boss.why: Automated browser-driven QA is a sandboxed action (drive a real browser), never a project write-primitive.

ui-boss.why: Visual/screenshot verification is the same sandboxed browser-QA action tier as Test Boss.

seo-boss.why: No default MCP grant — performance/SEO audits run on the project's own build/native tooling unless the owner explicitly widens this.

security-boss.why: No default MCP grant — security review stays on Claude's own reasoning + repo reads; remote/network tools are not auto-granted to a high-risk role.

skill-boss.why: Registry/skill-bundle maintenance is local file work — no MCP grant needed.

search-boss.why: Source-grounded research needs read-only web search/scrape/docs — never write access.

build-boss.why: Implementation gets local semantic code intelligence (LSP) only — remote/write tools stay out of the coding loop by default.

integration-boss.why: API/integration work needs versioned third-party API docs, plus n8n node docs/workflow validation for forge-n8n builds — read-only, never a live n8n connection (that stays on the separate tier-3 'n8n' entry, owner-gated).

docs-boss.why: No default MCP grant — documentation is authored from the repo's own real state.
